name: Editor Check: Harvesting And Building (Manual)
description: Roadmap 2026-10-05 STEP 2 §10: the Phase 13 visuals a person judges in the Unity Editor. The tool starts a sandbox server (DevRespawn: no match flow) on 127.0.0.1:7777; you press Play in the Editor and connect. A headless helper stands at QA_Build_Test (12.5, -12.5) next to a stone, a wood and a metal wall and a two-floor bridge; walk there (F1 shows your position). Each manualCheck pauses the run for PASS / FAIL. Keys: Q build mode, Z wall, X floor, V ramp, B roof, T material, R rotate, F harvest tool, 1-3 weapons.

steps.description: Press Play in the Unity Editor and connect to 127.0.0.1:7777. Walk to the helper at (12.5, -18) (F1 shows your position). Answer once you see the three walls and the bridge.
Wood, stone and metal walls look different from each other, with no magenta material and no flicker.
F (harvest tool): hit a tree, a rock and a metal object. Each hit adds to wood / stone / metal on the material HUD, a weak-point hit gives more, and the object shows hit feedback.
Q (build mode), Z wall: a preview ghost follows your aim in the valid colour; T switches the material on the HUD; R rotates the wall.
Aim at a slot that is taken (the stone wall) or out of reach: the preview turns the invalid colour and a click places nothing.
Place a wall (Z), a floor (X), a ramp (V) and a roof (B). Each appears at once (predicted), stays after the server confirms, and costs material on the HUD.
A freshly placed piece shows that it is still building up (and fills over about 1.5 s for wood). It does NOT look damaged.
Hold the left button and sweep the aim: pieces go down along the sweep (turbo build), never twice in the same slot, and no stutter.
Walk into your walls (blocked), run up the ramp, stand on the floor and on the roof slope, jump on the bridge: no sinking, no jitter, no getting stuck.
1 (weapon): shoot the wood wall at cell (21, 13), east of the bridge. Its damage shows (cracks or health) and more fire destroys it.
The stone wall under the bridge was just destroyed by the tool: the two bridge floors collapsed with it (dust puffs, no pieces left floating, nothing left in the air to stand on).
